otp_summary: NVMe Base 1.4 specifies several controller-identity fields that are factory-programmed and effectively OTP from the host's point of view. The primary container is the 4 KB Identify Controller data structure (CNS=01h) returned by the Admin Identify command. Per-namespace identity (NGUID, EUI64) is exposed in the Identify Namespace data structure (CNS=00h). The PCI Configuration Space Vendor ID (VID) / Device ID (DID) / Subsystem Vendor ID (SVID) / Subsystem Device ID (SSVID) are also factory-programmed.

otp_registers.name: Identify Controller — Identification fields
otp_registers.container: 4 KB Identify Controller structure (Admin OPC=06h, CNS=01h)

fields.name: VID  (PCI Vendor ID)
fields.description: PCI Vendor ID; SIG-assigned; mirrors PCI Config Space VID.

fields.name: SSVID (PCI Subsystem Vendor ID)
fields.description: PCI Subsystem Vendor ID; SIG-assigned; mirrors PCI Config Space SVID.

fields.name: SN    (Serial Number)
fields.description: ASCII string (right-padded with spaces) uniquely identifying the controller serial; factory-programmed.

fields.name: MN    (Model Number)
fields.description: ASCII string (right-padded with spaces) of the model name; factory-programmed.

fields.name: FR    (Firmware Revision)
fields.description: ASCII string of currently active firmware revision; updated by Firmware Commit.

fields.name: RAB   (Recommended Arbitration Burst)
fields.description: Recommended max burst size for arbitration; factory-set.

fields.name: IEEE  (IEEE OUI)
fields.description: IEEE-assigned OUI for vendor-specific NGUIDs / EUI64s; factory-programmed.

fields.name: CMIC  (Controller Multi-Path I/O and Namespace Sharing Capabilities)
fields.description: Bitmap: SR-IOV / multipath capabilities.

fields.name: MDTS  (Max Data Transfer Size)
fields.description: Max LBAs per single command = 2^MDTS × CAP.MPSMIN page; 0 = unlimited.

fields.name: CNTLID (Controller ID)
fields.description: Controller's unique ID within the NVM subsystem.

fields.name: VER   (Version)
fields.description: Mirrors VS register; factory-set.

fields.name: FGUID (FRU GUID)
fields.description: FRU Globally Unique Identifier; factory-programmed.

otp_registers.name: Identify Namespace — Identification fields (per-NSID)
otp_registers.container: 4 KB Identify Namespace structure (Admin OPC=06h, CNS=00h)

fields.name: NSZE  (Namespace Size)
fields.description: Size in logical blocks; reformattable via Format NVM.

fields.name: NCAP  (Namespace Capacity)
fields.description: Capacity in logical blocks; ≤ NSZE.

fields.name: NUSE  (Namespace Utilization)
fields.description: Current utilization; dynamic.

fields.name: NGUID (Namespace Globally Unique Identifier)
fields.description: 128-bit globally unique namespace identifier; factory-programmed; persistent across format if NSFEAT.OPTPERF=1.

fields.name: EUI64 (IEEE Extended Unique Identifier)
fields.description: 64-bit EUI; factory-programmed.

otp_registers.name: PCI Configuration Space — Identification
otp_registers.container: PCI Type 0 Configuration Header + Capability Structures

fields.name: Vendor ID
fields.description: PCI-SIG vendor.

fields.name: Device ID
fields.description: PCI-SIG device.

fields.name: Revision ID
fields.description: Revision.

fields.name: Class Code
fields.description: 0x010802 = Mass Storage / NVMe / NVM Express interface.

fields.name: Subsystem Vendor ID
fields.description: Subsystem vendor.

fields.name: Subsystem ID
fields.description: Subsystem device.

fields.name: Device Serial Number Capability
fields.description: 64-bit serial; factory-programmed if implemented (DSN Capability ID 03h).

non_otp_volatile_state: All controller volatile state — CC, CSTS (except hardwired bits), AQA, ASQ, ACQ, queue Head/Tail pointers, Phase Tag, current Feature values (unless 'saveable' bit set in Get Features.SEL=3) — resets on PCIe Conventional Reset / FLR / NSSR / Controller Reset.
notes: From the host's point of view, the controller's identity is fingerprinted by (VID, SSVID, SN, MN, FR, IEEE OUI, FGUID) from Identify Controller plus (NGUID, EUI64) per namespace. The Serial Number (SN) + Model Number (MN) + Firmware Revision (FR) + Vendor ID (VID) uniquely identify the SSD without host marking — used by enterprise inventory systems and by the TCG Opal Locking SP for drive identity binding. NGUID + EUI64 are persistent across power cycle and survive Format NVM if NSFEAT.OPTPERF is appropriately set (Section 5.15.2.1).
